name: water_brush
description: It's cool and refreshing. Water Brush is a contemporary script style. The dry brush texture is indicative of a camel hair brush filled with color on a watercolor textured paper. The characters are loose and expressive— perfect for casual and sophisticated situations. It comes with Latin Character sets including Western, Central, and Vietnamese language support. To contribute, see github.com/googlefonts/water-brush .
